known_prior: related KNOWN:G3-004 (G1-G5 code missing); reuse path not recorded
rule: RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 1 and section 4 G5 / holdout consumed marker; D032, D043
summary: The single-use holdout is protected only by procedure: no code writes or reads holdout_consumed.json, no check refuses a later manifest whose Development/Validation reuses the holdout period, and a new strategy_version is a new lineage allowed to evaluate the same holdout again.
expected: Holdout used once (or a machine-enforced limit) and a refusal when a later research window overlaps a designated holdout.
actual: require_authorized binds only grid hash, manifest hash and semantics version; DatasetManifest validates one manifest in isolation; protocol line 293 accepts erosion by successive lineages.
impact: None today (holdout untouched). After iteration on failed run 1, the 146-day holdout can become another validation set and a G5 pass would lose its meaning for the D059 go-live gate.
evidence: grep -rn holdout_consumed src returns nothing; authorization.py:110-125; manifest.py:367-403; RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md line 293 'successive lineages on one holdout window erode it, which the marker makes countable'.
reproduction: grep -rn holdout_consumed src scripts; read require_authorized.
why_tests_miss: No G5 harness exists; manifest tests check one manifest at a time.
recommendation: Owner decision O-1b; then a G5 harness that writes the marker before reading holdout data and a manifest check refusing overlap with a designated holdout.

summary: register.py reports VALID against whatever grid JSON the caller passes; the grid is not checked against a committed run authorization.
expected: VALID only for a point of a grid whose hash a committed authorization names.
actual: --grid is a free path; _grid_reason only parses it; no grid_hash comparison.
impact: A wrong VALID could be presented to the owner as the hash to authorise; no runtime caller.
evidence: register.py:282 '--grid ... required=True'; register.py:127-131, 134-142, 173-189; no caller of validate_candidate in src.
recommendation: Require --authorization and compare grid_hash(load_grid(grid)) with it.

component: analytics core metrics / backtest evidence block
rule: RESEARCH_PROTOCOL section 4 closed trade = SL or TP2 (SETTLEMENT never closed); METRICS.md section 2 'wins / closed trades'
summary: Analytics core metrics count END_OF_DATA and SETTLEMENT exits as R-valued trades and pool all passed experiments (grid points, folds, Development) into one BACKTEST block.
expected: Protocol closed-trade population, per parameter set, or an explicit label.
actual: Probe: SL -0.7, TP2 +2.0, END_OF_DATA +0.5, SETTLEMENT -0.9 -> analytics mean 0.225 R (n 4); protocol population mean 0.65 R (n 2).
impact: Misleading descriptive figure if read as research evidence; gates do not use it.
why_tests_miss: Tests use SL/TP outcomes of one parameter set.
recommendation: Filter or label END_OF_DATA/SETTLEMENT; refuse or split multi-parameter-set BACKTEST evidence.

summary: Live outcomes close only on fills of STOP_LOSS/TAKE_PROFIT_1/TAKE_PROFIT_2 plan orders; emergency, manual or liquidation closes never close the outcome, so those (typically worst) trades would stay OPEN_POSITION and be missing from live R.
expected: Any fill that flattens the plan's position ends the outcome with its net PnL.
actual: closed = bool(exit_fills) and total(exit_fills) >= entry_quantity with exit_fills limited to _EXIT_KINDS roles; OrderRole has no close role; emergency_close.py has no role reference.
impact: None now (live R INCOMPLETE while the semantics flag is False; placement disabled). With placement on, measured live expectancy biased upward.
evidence: live_outcomes.py _EXIT_KINDS and closed block; src/domain/enums.py:249-255; src/live/stream_persistence.py:403-412
reproduction: By reading: an ENTRY fill plus a fill of an order without a plan exit role yields OPEN_POSITION.
why_tests_miss: Fixtures close positions with SL/TP orders.
recommendation: Attribute close orders to the plan and count them as exits; give an unexplained flat position its own INCOMPLETE reason.

rule: METRICS section 6 diagnostics; RESEARCH assumption A6
summary: MFE/MAE windows include the whole entry minute and whole exit minute, so pre-fill and post-exit prices enter the excursions (backtest fill needs a trade-through, so MAE is always at least one tick from the fill minute).
expected: Excursions measured from the fill onward.
actual: Probe: LONG fill 100 dated at the minute close, entry-minute low 98 -> MAE 2 = 1.0 R reported.
impact: Descriptive bias in stop/target diagnostics; no gate uses it.
recommendation: Start the window after the fill minute for backtest evidence or report the entry-minute range separately.
